evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature rising smoothly 355.7→359.5 °C with decelerating slope, consistent with steady boil-up
Mid-column temperatures creeping up slowly (~2-3 °C over 20 min), gradient preserved
Top/condenser temperatures stable at ~67.2-67.8 °C, stable light-cut plateau
Reflux ~0.32 L/h, distillate ~0.52 L/h, ratio noisy ~6 but steady
Differential pressures steady ~0.8/2.0 mbar and system pressure ~598 mbar, no flooding or blockage
